application: Candidate = frozen causal full-champion hinge bits on present rows; on missing rows candidate = clip(R06_baseline + delta, 0, 100).
comparator: The same frozen full champion, including exact R06 fallback on missing rows (delta zero).
disclosures: D2 selection cycles 68-75 include D1 score cycles 72-75; those labels are used only for the matching D2 calibration fit before D1 scoring QA.
D1 and D2 score rows are distinct but not independent validation; E75 training includes earlier D1 cycles.
The median minimizes unclipped absolute residual loss; it is not claimed to globally optimize clipped score MAE.
final_source: Only after independent metric QA and exploratory eligibility, prepare target-free unique OOF source for E67 cycles 68-75 plus E75 cycles 76-79; do not fit the final delta or run E79 before root review.

gates.exploratory: Both folds supported; pooled full-population MAE gain > 0; no fold missing-MAE harm > 0.10; maximum supported-group harm <= 0.25; present predictions bit-identical; independent QA PASS.
gates.scientific: Both folds supported; missing MAE gain > 0 in both folds; pooled full-population MAE gain > 0; maximum supported-group harm <= 0.25; present predictions bit-identical; independent QA PASS.

hypothesis: The R06 missing-stream fallback has a temporally persistent location residual that can be corrected by a median learned only from earlier missing OOF rows.
metrics: D1/D2 missing MAE and signed residual/bias
inherited REG fixed groups and tails with n>=100
parent: five-learner full champion with frozen causal P50 hinge; preserve all present prediction bits
residual_sign: residual = y - R06_baseline; positive residual raises the prediction
selection: For missing selection rows only, delta = median(y - R06_baseline). Fit one scalar per fold. No shrink, cap, grid, sign selection, alternate quantile, or tuned window.
